observations.seen: Frame 1 has readable daylight on the grass, but frames 3 and 4 are flat. The Ember scene is a single brown-red tone with no key light separating the floor, the walls and the props.

Frame 1 shows no visible contact shadow under Pip on the grass, and the trees cast no shadows onto the ground. Frames 3 and 4 have soft character shadows, and the frame 3 shadow stretches a long way sideways.
Nearly every surface reads as matte. Only the metal cage towers in frame 4 show faint specular, and the blue crystal and rings in frame 1 show no environment reflection.
The floating platform islands, sun-gate arch, windmill and lava-cellar set give each world its own identity. The faceted low-poly trees sit next to high-detail props and look unfinished beside them.
Distance haze in frame 1 works. In frame 4 the brown fog swallows the background, and the ember particles are small and sparse.

The grass in frame 1 uses a low-resolution, blocky noise texture that shows pixel stepping up close. The deck in frame 3 is mostly flat orange with stripes only at the lower left, and the frame 4 floor is untextured. The crate and barrel have good wood grain.
Pip is appealing and well modeled, and the crate, barrel and windmill read well. The trees are crude faceted cones. The photoreal metal towers in frame 4 clash with the stylized character.
In frame 1, close trees on the right cover about a third of the frame. In frame 3, an empty orange deck fills the lower half. In frame 1, a stray blue-white slab floats beside Pip.
The camera follows from directly behind Pip instead of side-on as the recipe expects. Pip fills about 12 to 15% of the frame, below the 18 to 25% target.
Frame 3 has a heavy dark vignette. A white diagonal streak artifact crosses the grass in frame 1. Grading in frames 3 and 4 is muddy rather than daylight-outdoor.

The cream pill HUD and the Vale Atlas modal are consistent and legible. The HUD is missing in frames 3 and 4, the atlas cards show stray '...' placeholder lines, and the debug-style world nav bar crowds the top edge.
